title: Fresh ErrorPrepared refusal does not report its frozen diagnostics

contract.text: Fresh no-Error consumption only checks stored diagnostics; it does NOT append their Warning vector early. Append a defensive stored-I issue copy exactly ONCE at the original late-I slot per validation invocation, after late sealed-N. Error-held delivery reports its frozen issues at the owning refusal without entering late/common.

scenario: A genuine selected fresh operation prepares and commits a result containing an Error. Owning release returns; canonical refresh retains Prepared and its issues, then exits with publication-held disposition.
actualSourceBehavior: ValidationAndRepair stores and returns the frozen issue vector, but its joint branch directly calls ValidateMortalJointPostPublicationAsync; the noncommitted guard returns Held before enumerating/reporting issues. The outer owner displays only generic recovery text. Resume separately logs each frozen issue.
consequence: The first owning refusal fails the accepted diagnostics-delivery contract even though durable retention is present; the concrete repair cause is not delivered on that invocation.
requiredCorrection: Report the frozen ordered diagnostic vector at the selected fresh owning refusal without interactive ordinary validation prompts, repair, recomputation, I publication, or common effects. Verify actual delivered diagnostic contents rather than only reading the stored record.
existingControlLimit: AssertHeld currently proves Prepared/Error/current bytes and no effects; it does not observe logger/UI delivery.
scopeLimits: Source-derived only; no native test execution or observed runtime failure.
S03 and final integrated SOURCE remain open; this does not introduce a new architecture gate.
